Boxes.Name: CLAUDE.md abbd block
Boxes.Title: DATA-0001 CLAUDE.md abbd block: Defines the block text between <!-- abbd:begin --> and <!-- abbd:end -->, and the rule that a marker counts only alone on its line and outside fenced code, preserving the file's line endings.

Boxes.Name: review commands
Boxes.Title: MOD-0002 review commands: Owns diff against the units committed at a base revision with the --check boundary failure, the evidence live/dead report, and the status freshness and counts.

Boxes.Name: argv parsing and dispatch
Boxes.Title: MOD-0003 argv parsing and dispatch: Owns the command table walk: two-word verbs, the setup-only -- argv split, flags interspersed with positionals, the positional count check, and calling publish after a writing verb.

Boxes.Name: sync pipeline
Boxes.Title: MOD-0004 sync pipeline: Owns run script, parse, reconcile IDs across git renames, apply evidence, save units and candidates, then write state.yaml with a revision that moves only when the tree fingerprint does.

Boxes.Name: query commands
Boxes.Title: MOD-0005 query commands: Owns resolving a unit by ID, exact name or near name, and printing topology's explain, path and impact results with names, origins and how's CURRENT or STALE text.

Boxes.Name: record writers
Boxes.Title: MOD-0006 record writers: Owns record relation, record unit, record fact and understand: checking every quote against the tree, the origin precedence EXTRACTED over USER_STATED over INFERRED, the duplicate-code refusal, and refusing to restamp unchanged how text onto changed code.

Boxes.Name: blueprint publish
Boxes.Title: MOD-0007 blueprint publish: Owns loading the screen input with the current tree snapshot and writing index.html then graph.json, the watermark file last.

Boxes.Name: setup determinism proof and supplement fold
Boxes.Title: MOD-0008 setup determinism proof and supplement fold: Owns the three-run determinism proof (the third with reseeded PYTHONHASHSEED and PERL_HASH_SEED), reading the supplement relative to the root, and folding it over the script output before syncing with guesses replaced.

Units.Name: store staleness hashes

Boxes.Name: diff report fields
Boxes.Title: DATA-0009 diff report fields: Fixes the JSON field names of the diff (units_added, units_removed, contract_signatures_changed, contract_code_changed, relations_added, relations_removed, inferred_added) that abbd diff --json prints.

Boxes.Name: top-level unit rule
Boxes.Title: DATA-0011 top-level unit rule: a unit is top level when it has no parent; the screen also lifts a unit whose parent is absent, while diff, understand and explain test the Parent field alone

Boxes.Name: origin strength order
Boxes.Title: DATA-0013 origin strength order: EXTRACTED beats USER_STATED beats INFERRED; topology ranks paths by it, the screen picks a wire's origin with its own copy, identity keeps the extracted copy of a repeated edge

Boxes.Name: contract code digest
Boxes.Title: DATA-0021 contract code digest: the extraction script's digest of a contract's code; identity carries it, bootstrap clears it for a reader's unit, and diff reads an empty digest as unknown and a changed one as code changed under the same signature

Boxes.Name: contract provider rule
Boxes.Title: DATA-0023 contract provider rule: which module provides a contract; topology counts only a provides relation, while the screen also counts the module a contract sits inside

Boxes.Name: boundary rule
Boxes.Title: MOD-0048 boundary rule: Decides that a diff reaches the boundary when a contract's signature changed, a contract was added or removed, or a drawn relation between top-level units appeared or went; a contract's code change under the same signature does not count.

Boxes.Name: topology diff
Boxes.Title: MOD-0049 topology diff: Compares two unit sets into sorted categories: units added and removed, contract signatures changed, contract code changed under the same signature, drawn relations between top-level units (an inside unit's relation lifted to its module), and reader couplings added.

Boxes.Name: impact walk
Boxes.Title: MOD-0050 impact walk: Walks from the seeds (and units inside seed modules) to dependents, consumers, contract providers and provided contracts, marks what the seeds use without following it, and splits the result into a direct and a far tier.

Boxes.Name: live links
Boxes.Title: MOD-0051 live links: Lists every relation between present units that is not dead, extracted, stated or inferred, with its origin, via and evidence, and labels each with where it comes from.

Boxes.Name: unit explanation
Boxes.Title: MOD-0052 unit explanation: Gathers one present unit, the units inside it, its drawn links out and in (counting an inside unit's link across the boundary as the unit's own), and the reader couplings touching it or anything inside it.

Boxes.Name: strongest shortest path
Boxes.Title: MOD-0053 strongest shortest path: Finds the shortest undirected walk over live links and, among equally short walks, the one whose weakest hop is strongest by the order extracted over stated over inferred, and reports that weakest origin.

Parts.Text: does, from the registered script to the rendered blueprint. Everything after the extraction runs inside

Steps.Does: LoadProject() reads project.yaml → the registered extraction argv
Steps.Fails: stops when project.yaml names no script; run abbd setup first

Steps.Does: runScript(argv) → the script's stdout, run in the project root
Steps.Fails: stops when the script exits non-zero, and prints its stderr

Steps.Does: Parse(stdout) → extract.Result, the units by ref with anchors and relations
Quotes: internal/extract/extract.go:97 "func Parse(r io.Reader) (Result, error) { return parse(r, false) }"

Steps.Does: Writable(), LoadCandidates(), LoadState() → stored units, candidates, last state
Steps.Note: LoadState reads a state a merge left with both sides' lines as one, marked Merged
Steps.Fails: Writable refuses a state with a unit file in the old format; run abbd migrate

Steps.Note: .abbd/ is left out, so committing the state leaves the tree unchanged

Steps.Does: Renames(last fingerprint, tree) → files moved since the last sync
Steps.Fails: warns and finds no moves when the last snapshot is gone

Steps.Does: Head() → the revision, taken only when the tree changed
Steps.Note: a sync of an unchanged tree keeps the stored revision

Steps.Does: Reconcile(stored, renames, extraction, prior) → units with their IDs kept
Steps.Fails: refuses an extraction with no units while units are stored
Quotes: cmd/abbd/main.go:400 "the extraction reported no units; refusing to mark every unit absent"

Steps.Does: Apply(units, rev) → every quote live, drifted or dead
Steps.Note: a drifted quote dies at the first sync of a later revision
